knobs.name: hook1In
knobs.what: s: the belief (set type) fades in over the empty floor

knobs.name: hook1Out
knobs.what: s: the belief starts to fade (gone 0.5 s later)

knobs.name: hook2In
knobs.what: s: the doubt ("Does it?") fades in

knobs.name: hook2Out
knobs.what: s: the doubt starts to fade (gone before CASE at 12)

knobs.name: hookSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the belief, display face (must-read)

knobs.name: tileT0
knobs.what: s: the first task tile drops onto the floor

knobs.name: tileT1
knobs.what: s: the last task tile has landed (before the count callout)

knobs.name: cTasks
knobs.what: s: callout on the task count (the first count; count.at)

knobs.name: cubeT0
knobs.what: s: four cubes per tile start to arrive (2 x 2 footprint, unlit ghosts)

knobs.name: cubeT1
knobs.what: s: the last cube has arrived

knobs.name: cTries
knobs.what: s: callout on the try count

knobs.name: litT0
knobs.what: s: the passing tries start to light gold, in a seeded order

knobs.name: litT1
knobs.what: s: the last passing try is lit

knobs.name: cPass
knobs.what: s: callout on the passed count

knobs.name: cPct
knobs.what: s: callout on the share of tries that pass (a ratio, 1.5 s or more after its count)

knobs.name: cPctEnd
knobs.what: s: that callout ends before the first move

knobs.name: m1T0
knobs.what: s: M1 starts: plan to side (the field re-stacks into columns under an orbit)

knobs.name: m1T1
knobs.what: s: M1 lands on the side key (hold, T8)

knobs.name: cAll
knobs.what: s: callout on one column lit all the way (words only)

knobs.name: cNone
knobs.what: s: the callout hard-cuts to a column with no lit cube

knobs.name: cNoneEnd
knobs.what: s: that callout ends before M2

knobs.name: m2T0
knobs.what: s: M2 starts: the same columns re-sort by tries passed (camera still)

knobs.name: m2T1
knobs.what: s: M2 lands (skyline: full columns left, empty right)

knobs.name: c44
knobs.what: s: callout on the full block (tasks that pass all four tries)

knobs.name: c22
knobs.what: s: the callout hard-cuts to the empty block (tasks that never pass)

knobs.name: c22End
knobs.what: s: that callout ends before the cut plane rises

knobs.name: m3T0
knobs.what: s: M3 starts: the cut plane rises from the floor (columns below it dim, none removed)

knobs.name: m3T1
knobs.what: s: the plane rests at the all-four bar

knobs.name: c44of
knobs.what: s: callout: the exact count of columns lit all the way, of all tasks

knobs.name: c383
knobs.what: s: callout: the share that passes all four tries (>= 1.5 s after the count)

knobs.name: c383End
knobs.what: s: that callout ends

knobs.name: lad1
knobs.what: s: the ratio row opens with one try

knobs.name: lad2
knobs.what: s: both of two tries

knobs.name: lad3
knobs.what: s: all of three tries

knobs.name: lad4
knobs.what: s: all four tries (gold)

knobs.name: ladOut
knobs.what: s: the ratio row starts to fade

knobs.name: legOut
knobs.what: s: the unit legend (top left) fades before the ratio row and the plate need that corner

knobs.name: paperIn
knobs.what: s: the plate attributed to the paper's own eight-try run

knobs.name: paperOut
knobs.what: s: that plate starts to fade

knobs.name: planeOut
knobs.what: s: the cut plane and its pin fade

knobs.name: prCut
knobs.what: s: hard cut from the tau floor to the sheet of pull requests (new dataset; labels cut too)

knobs.name: prT0
knobs.what: s: the first pull request cube arrives

knobs.name: prT1
knobs.what: s: the last pull request cube has arrived

knobs.name: cPrs
knobs.what: s: callout on the pull-request count

knobs.name: cSwe
knobs.what: s: callout on the top SWE-bench Verified score (a different set: tests only)

knobs.name: cSweEnd
knobs.what: s: that callout ends before M4

knobs.name: m4T0
knobs.what: s: M4 starts: the same cubes re-partition into would merge / would not merge (camera still)

knobs.name: m4T1
knobs.what: s: M4 lands (two equal blocks, schematic)

knobs.name: ghost0
knobs.what: s: the not-merged block starts to dim to ghost

knobs.name: ghost1
knobs.what: s: the not-merged block is dimmed

knobs.name: cHalf
knobs.what: s: callout: about half would not be merged (words, no digit)

knobs.name: cHalfEnd
knobs.what: s: that callout ends

knobs.name: minCut
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the horizon: two columns of minutes (new dataset)

knobs.name: min27T0
knobs.what: s: the first minute cube of the 80 % column arrives

knobs.name: min27T1
knobs.what: s: the 80 % column is full

knobs.name: cMin27
knobs.what: s: callout on the 80 % horizon

knobs.name: cMin27End
knobs.what: s: that callout ends

knobs.name: min289T0
knobs.what: s: the first minute cube of the 50 % column arrives

knobs.name: min289T1
knobs.what: s: the 50 % column is full

knobs.name: cMin289
knobs.what: s: callout on the 50 % horizon

knobs.name: cRatio
knobs.what: s: callout hard-cuts to the ratio of the two horizons (about, nearest ten)

knobs.name: cRatioEnd
knobs.what: s: that callout ends

knobs.name: tauCut
knobs.what: s: hard cut back to the tau floor (the bookend)

knobs.name: bookT0
knobs.what: s: the camera rises back to the plan pose of the opening

knobs.name: bookT1
knobs.what: s: the camera is back in plan

knobs.name: dimT0
knobs.what: s: the floor dims so the Monday type reads

knobs.name: qIn
knobs.what: s: the Monday question fades in

knobs.name: qOut
knobs.what: s: the question starts to fade

knobs.name: honestIn
knobs.what: s: the one honest-limits line fades in (stage type; no caption shows after 141)

knobs.name: mondaySize
knobs.what: sheet units: the Monday question

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the honest-limits line

knobs.name: mondayDim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far the floor is mixed toward the ground under the Monday type

knobs.name: camFov
knobs.what: degrees: vertical field of view, fixed for the whole film (I5 same lens)

knobs.name: camPlanEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the plan pose (89 = straight down)

knobs.name: camPlanDist
knobs.what: world units: eye distance in the plan pose of the tau floor

knobs.name: camLookZ
knobs.what: world units: aim point along z in the tau poses (positive lifts the field on screen)

knobs.name: camSideAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth swept by M1 (the side key)

knobs.name: camSideEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the side key (lower hides back rows, higher flattens the columns)

knobs.name: camSideLookZ
knobs.what: world units: aim point along z in the side key (lower puts the field lower on screen, clear of the type above)

knobs.name: camSideR
knobs.what: factor: eye distance of the side key relative to the plan pose

knobs.name: camPrDist
knobs.what: world units: eye distance over the sheet of pull requests (plan)

knobs.name: camPrLookZ
knobs.what: world units: aim point along z over the pull-request sheet

knobs.name: camMinAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the horizon view

knobs.name: camMinEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the horizon view

knobs.name: camMinDist
knobs.what: world units: eye distance of the horizon view

knobs.name: camMinLookY
knobs.what: world units: height the horizon view aims at

knobs.name: bookDist
knobs.what: world units: eye distance of the bookend plan pose (farther than the opening so the top band is free for type)

knobs.name: bookLookZ
knobs.what: world units: aim point along z in the bookend (negative lowers the field on screen)

knobs.name: driftDeg
knobs.what: degrees: amplitude of the ambient yaw drift (R-E P12; at most 3)

knobs.name: driftPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the ambient yaw drift

knobs.name: cubeEdge
knobs.what: world units: edge of one cube (never changes inside a move, I3)

knobs.name: cubeGap
knobs.what: fraction of an edge: seam between cubes

knobs.name: tileGap
knobs.what: edges: aisle between task tiles

knobs.name: gridCols
knobs.what: task tiles per row on the floor (rows follow from the task count)

knobs.name: prCols
knobs.what: pull-request cubes per row in the sheet (rows follow from the count)

knobs.name: prGap
knobs.what: rows: aisle between the merged and not-merged blocks

knobs.name: barCols
knobs.what: minute cubes per row in a horizon column

knobs.name: barGap
knobs.what: cubes: aisle between the two horizon columns

knobs.name: prZ
knobs.what: world units: where the pull-request floor sits (far from the tau floor so it never enters its frame)

knobs.name: minX
knobs.what: world units: where the horizon floor sits

knobs.name: seedLit
knobs.what: seed: the order the passing tries light in (a permutation made once in setup)

knobs.name: seedMerge
knobs.what: seed: which pull requests land in which block (schematic, exactly half and half)

knobs.name: shadeFront
knobs.what: face light: front (+z)

knobs.name: shadeBack
knobs.what: face light: back (-z)

knobs.name: shadeRight
knobs.what: face light: right (+x)

knobs.name: shadeLeft
knobs.what: face light: left (-x)

knobs.name: ghostMix
knobs.what: 0-1: an unlit cube, ground toward muted

knobs.name: plateMix
knobs.what: 0-1: a task tile's plate, ground toward muted

knobs.name: floorMix
knobs.what: 0-1: the floor, ground toward panel

knobs.name: gridAlpha
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the faint floor grid

knobs.name: gridStep
knobs.what: tile pitches between grid lines

knobs.name: floorSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of the floor square

knobs.name: cutDim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far a column below the plane is mixed toward the ground (dims, never removes)

knobs.name: planeAlpha
knobs.what: 0-1: fill opacity of the cut plane

knobs.name: planeMargin
knobs.what: world units: how far the plane overhangs the field

knobs.name: arrW
knobs.what: fraction of a count-in window one mark takes to drop and grow into place

knobs.name: drop
knobs.what: world units: height a mark falls from as it arrives

knobs.name: lift1
knobs.what: world units: arc height of a cube leaving its tile cell in M1

knobs.name: lift2
knobs.what: world units: arc height of a column crossing the floor in M2

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: 0-1: how spread out in time the marks of one move leave (each keeps its own path)

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: sheet units: leader length of an ordinary pin

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: label budget per frame for ordinary pins

knobs.name: calloutLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: leader length of the callout

knobs.name: calloutSize
knobs.what: sheet units: callout type (result, display face)

knobs.name: dispAdv
knobs.what: em: average advance of the display face, for label boxes

knobs.name: subGap
knobs.what: sheet units: extra air between a label's number and the line under it (keeps descenders off the second line)

knobs.name: plate
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the ground-coloured plate behind a label

knobs.name: ladSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the ratio row

knobs.name: plateSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the paper's eight-try sentence
